text: Android: copy a list into another account or the local area (B4)

From the B2 review: the removal dialog already says lists to keep can be copied to another account first; B4 makes that true and, with B3 present, the wording must name the local area. Also: OverviewViewModel.joinInvite/RedeemViewModel get a shared invite helper in the B2 follow-ups; copy should not add a third copy of that shape.

Merged as three cherry-picked commits (HEAD 473043d), full gate green. Review: duplicate(listId, targetAccountId) refuses a ledger across accounts and a kind the target cannot hold, strips roster/votes/closedAt, copies currency and item expenses; the picker orders own account first, local area last; Duplicate stays hidden for ledgers on both clients (T-155), so the ticket's ledger picker + reason string were not built. 15 mutations caught.
